entities.name: Query protein PurT
observations: 393 aa protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A3N1B2 and B3GXZ2, with 100% identity and full-length coverage.
Predicted ATP-grasp domain spans approximately residues 121-300; PurT_C domain spans approximately residues 321-388.
Likely homodimeric cytosolic enzyme based on curated homolog annotations.

entities.name: PurT formyltransferase
observations: Catalyzes ATP-dependent transfer of formate to 5-phosphoribosylglycinamide (GAR), yielding formyl-GAR (FGAR), ADP, and phosphate.
Curated homolog annotations indicate ATP binding and magnesium ion binding; formate is supplied by PurU-mediated hydrolysis of 10-formyl-tetrahydrofolate.
Curated homolog annotations indicate a homodimeric cytosolic enzyme.

entities.name: De novo purine biosynthesis
observations: PurT catalyzes the GAR-to-FGAR step in the formate route of IMP biosynthesis.
This is an early committed transformation in de novo purine metabolism and contributes to construction of the purine ring.
